capabilities: Replace a selected Bible reference with a Markdown link via a command
Parse references in natural format, including abbreviations and verse ranges
Configure link URL templates with verse, version, book, and chapter tokens
Choose built-in presets for BibleGateway, Olive Tree, and route.bible
Validate book names against an internal dictionary
extras: Book-name recognition currently supports only Spanish (sp) and English (en) languages; Olive Tree links ignore Bible versions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Bible references in notes into links that open the passage on an external Bible tool.

relations.evidence: BibleGateway for providing a great and free online Bible tool.

summary: Bible reference linker that replaces a selected reference like John 3:16 with a Markdown link to a configured online Bible site or app.
